name: PocketBase
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: PocketBase is an open source backend in one file, with a database, authentication, file storage and an admin dashboard. Open the link it prints on the first start to create your superuser, or set one below.
startup: if [ -n "${SUPERUSER_EMAIL:-}" ] && [ -n "${SUPERUSER_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then ./pocketbase superuser upsert "$SUPERUSER_EMAIL" "$SUPERUSER_PASSWORD" --dir pb_data || exit 1; fi; exec ./pocketbase serve --http 0.0.0.0:{{SERVER_PORT}} --dir pb_data

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# PocketBase: downloads PocketBase from its GitHub releases, checked
# against GitHub's SHA-256. pb_data (the database and uploaded files),
# pb_public, pb_hooks and pb_migrations are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
# Downloads unpack in a folder in the server's (the install's /tmp is
# small), removed when the script ends.
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) echo "PocketBase has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))."; exit 1 ;;
esac

version="${VERSION:-latest}"
[ "$version" = latest ] || version="v${version#v}"
# gh-release says why when the release doesn't exist or GitHub can't be reached.
tag=$(gh-release tag pocketbase/pocketbase "$version") || exit 1

if [ -x pocketbase ] && [ "$(cat .pocketbase-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then
    echo "PocketBase $tag is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading PocketBase $tag."
    gh-release download pocketbase/pocketbase "$tag" "pocketbase_${tag#v}_linux_${arch}.zip" $work/pb.zip
    unzip -qo $work/pb.zip pocketbase -d $work
    install -m 0755 $work/pocketbase pocketbase.new
    mv -f pocketbase.new pocketbase
    echo "$tag" > .pocketbase-version
fi
echo "Installed PocketBase $tag."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The PocketBase version to install, such as 0.40.6, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Superuser email
variables.description: With a password, creates this superuser at every start, or resets its password to the one below.

variables.name: Superuser password
variables.description: The superuser's password, at least 8 characters. Leave both empty to set the superuser up in the browser.
